capabilities: map any Obsidian command to a system-wide key combination
bring the Obsidian window to the front on command
show or hide Obsidian via extra commands
extras: The settings format follows Electron's accelerator syntax; the README lists a to-do item to improve the hotkey settings.
intentEvidence: adding support for system-wide global hotkeys
problem: Obsidian's built-in hotkeys only work while the app window is focused, so commands cannot be run from other applications.
summary: Hotkey plugin that lets users trigger any Obsidian command from anywhere via system-wide key combinations.
